ceviri.20: What is a brand identity, and how is it different from just a logo?
ceviri.21: The logo is the brand's mark, while the brand identity is a whole system covering the colour palette, typography, visual language and rules of use. The identity guidelines make sure the logo is applied consistently across every channel.
ceviri.22: What stages does a logo go through before it's delivered?
ceviri.23: The process runs through a discovery call, concept sketches, vector production of the chosen direction, and a final check. At delivery you get the vector source files together with the different usage formats.
ceviri.24: What makes business card and catalogue design prices vary?
ceviri.25: The cost is set by things like the number of pages, how complex the content is, whether illustration is needed and the delivery format. Current package details are in the pricing section.
ceviri.26: What formats is a catalogue delivered in?
ceviri.27: A catalogue can be prepared as a high-resolution, print-ready PDF, or as an interactive digital file with a page-turn effect on screen. Where it's needed, both formats are delivered together.
ceviri.28: Are social media templates part of the package, or offered separately?
ceviri.29: The template set is offered either as an add-on module to the brand identity package or as a standalone service. The scope is settled during the call, according to what the brand needs.
ceviri.30: Can we keep our existing logo and just have brand identity guidelines produced?
ceviri.31: Yes — the existing logo can be analysed and kept, with guidelines produced covering only colour, typography and rules of use. If the logo needs revising, that's assessed separately.

ceviri.48: Graphic Design Agency Services: Logo, Brand Identity and Visual Templates
ceviri.49: As a graphic design agency, TasarımMania produces your brand's logo, brand identity guidelines, business card and catalogue designs and social media templates under one roof. This work runs independently of your website's interface design, and aims to keep your brand consistent on every surface, printed and digital.
ceviri.50: Let's map the scope and price range
ceviri.63: How does the process run, from logo to brand identity guidelines?
ceviri.64: The logo is the brand's single visual signature, while the brand identity guidelines are a thorough set of rules describing how that signature is used in every setting.
ceviri.65: The process starts with a discovery call that settles the brand's values and its audience. The direction is then set through concept sketches and a moodboard, and the chosen concept is produced in vector format. At this stage the colour palette, typographic hierarchy and logo variants (horizontal, vertical, mark) are defined together. The guidelines document brings the minimum size, clear space, examples of prohibited use and the colour codes together in one file. That way, different agencies or in-house teams all apply the brand to the same standard.
ceviri.67: The Technical Difference Between Business Cards, Catalogues and Social Media Templates
ceviri.68: Business card and catalogue files going to print need a CMYK colour profile, bleed and high resolution, while digital catalogues and social media templates are prepared in RGB and optimized for screens.
ceviri.69: Depending on the number of products and the page layout, a catalogue can be delivered as a print-ready PDF or as an interactive digital format with a page-turn effect. Social media templates come in different ratios — post, story, cover image — matched to the brand's colours and typography, in editable layers. The aim is for the same brand identity to appear intact on every channel. Because pricing and delivery times vary with the package, those details are covered in the pricing section. The design delivered is a creative work;

_kararlar.9/48 H1: 'Graphic Design Agency Services: Logo, Brand Identity and Visual Templates'. Türkçedeki 'Hizmeti' eki İngilizcede 'Services' ile karşılandı; başlık hem şemada hem H1'de aynı olduğu için tek karşılık kullanıldı.
_kararlar.20-21 kurumsal kimlik → brand identity: İngilizcede 'corporate identity' de var ama günümüz tasarım registerinde 'brand identity' standart. 'Kimlik kılavuzu' → 'brand identity guidelines' (çoğul; İngilizcede bu doküman çoğul adlandırılır).
_kararlar.53 ONAYA HAZIR → READY FOR SIGN-OFF: 'Ready for approval' de doğru ama tasarım süreçlerinde İngiltere'de 'sign-off' yerleşik terim; sayfanın 134. kaydında da 'Sign-Off Flow' kullanıldı, tutarlı.
_kararlar.57-61 rozet etiketleri: RENK/VARYANT/TESLİM → COLOUR/VARIANTS/DELIVERY. 'VARYANT' Türkçede tekil ama logo varyantları çoğul; İngilizcede çoğul doğal.
_kararlar.76 Koruma alanı → Clear space: Logo çevresinde bırakılan boşluğun sektör terimi 'clear space' (bazen 'exclusion zone'). Birebir 'protection area' anlaşılmazdı.
_kararlar.79 Simge → Icon: Logo varyantı olarak 'mark' da kullanılır; ama 74/75'te 'mark' zaten logonun kendisi için kullanıldığı için varyant adı 'Icon' seçildi — aynı kelimenin iki farklı şeyi göstermesi kafa karıştırırdı.
_kararlar.70 telif mevzuatı → copyright law: Eser sahipliği bağlamında doğru karşılık; 'royalty legislation' yanlış olurdu (o ödeme mevzuatı).
_kararlar.101 temsilî görsel notu: Sayfanın dürüstlük notu — görselin gerçek marka logosu OLMADIĞINI söylüyor. Birebir korundu, hiçbir iddia yumuşatılmadı.
_kararlar.167-168 Daha fazla / Daha az: Uzun bölümleri açıp kapatan düğme. Site genelinde 23 sayfada aynı çift var; burada da 'More' / 'Less' kullanıldı.
